name: Polynomial Depth Cueing
aliases: Fourier Projection-Slice with Polynomial Depth Cueing
Specular Reflections via Polynomial Depth Cueing
definition: An adaptation of the specular reflection method to provide non-linear (e.g., inverse square law) depth cueing by replacing N and H with D and V in the polynomial expansion.
summary: Polynomial Depth Cueing extends Fourier projection-slice volume rendering by replacing linear attenuation with non-linear depth cues or specular reflections, using precomputed spectra to disambiguate depth at high computational cost.
